create_deferred_batchnorm: create a DeferredBatchNorm layer that tracks running statistics per mini-batch across multiple micro-batches
convert_batchnorm_to_deferred: convert nn.BatchNorm modules in a model to DeferredBatchNorm with a specified chunk count
track_microbatch_statistics: track micro-batch statistics in DeferredBatchNorm by summing inputs and computing running mean and variance
commit_mini_batch_statistics: commit accumulated micro-batch statistics to update the running mean and variance of DeferredBatchNorm
run_deferred_batchnorm_forward: run a DeferredBatchNorm forward pass that normalizes micro-batch inputs during training or uses running stats during evaluation
